prompt: Character turnaround reference sheet of an original anime character, one single landscape image. From left to right, THREE full-body standing views of the SAME woman, evenly spaced, each fully visible from the top of the head to the shoes with margin around it: (1) FRONT view, facing the viewer; (2) RIGHT SIDE view, exact 90-degree pure profile facing to the right; (3) BACK view, seen from directly behind: we see the back of her head and short hair, her face is NOT visible at all. Neutral relaxed standing pose in all three views, feet slightly apart, both arms hanging naturally at the sides. All three views show exactly the same person with identical face, hairstyle, hair colour, clothing, accessories and body proportions. Identity: use the reference image ONLY for her face, facial features, eye colour, hairstyle and hair colour. She is a young ADULT woman in her mid twenties with normal realistic adult body proportions (about 7 heads tall), slim, not exaggerated; NOT a child, NOT childlike, NOT a loli, NOT chibi. Short grey-blue (slate blue-grey) bob haircut exactly like the reference, with the same side-swept bangs; brown eyes, calm cool expression; facial features as in the reference, with a natural softly rounded chin and jawline. Outfit (do NOT copy the outfit of the reference image): a teal-green (blue-green) long-sleeved knit sweater, slightly loose fit, neckline slightly open showing a little of the collarbones while the shoulders stay covered; slim-fit black long trousers; black flat shoes. Accessory: a thin delicate silver chain necklace with one small pendant resting just below the collarbones. NO choker, NO collar, NO black neckband of any kind on the neck (the black choker in the reference must be removed); no other jewellery. Overall look clean, understated, slightly cool and aloof. Plain solid light grey background, no scenery, no floor objects, no props. Soft even lighting. Clean Japanese anime illustration style matching the reference image: clean line art, soft cel shading. Absolutely no text, no labels, no captions, no arrows, no numbers, no watermark, no logo.
